messages:
Nadia P.: Heads-up: onboarding pipeline for EU region is experiencing delayed file processing between 05:40-05:58 UTC due to S3 throttling on the ingestion bucket. Some onboarding jobs are stuck in 'waiting-for-files' state. :warning:
Rafael G.: seeing 503s from S3 in the ingestion service logs, example: 
```
ERROR ingest: s3 GetObject failed key=onboard/acct-92a/manifest.json err=SlowDown
```
Maya L.: Are retries backing up the queue? could cause tenant setup timeouts.
Chris H.: Yes — worker backoff is exponential and retries are requeued, leading to a backlog in the ingest-consumer queue. 
Zoe T.: CS impact: 6 high-touch onboarders in the window; 2 are renewal-risk (renewal in 7 days). Want to notify AMs?
Nadia P.: Notify AMs immediately. Offer expedited manual replays and a one-time onboarding credit.
Rafael G.: Mitigations in flight: 1) throttle client-side retries to reduce S3 pressure, 2) switch to S3 read-prefetch cache for manifests, 3) kick manual replays for stuck tenants. I'm opening ENG ticket ENG-7810 with logs.
sre-oncall-bot: Alert: increased 503s from s3-ingest eu-west (05:42 UTC).
Maya L.: Draft high-touch comm: "Hi <CustomerName>, between 05:40-05:58 UTC we experienced delayed onboarding for some tenants due to upstream storage rate limits. Our engineers applied temporary retry throttling and initiated replay for your tenant. Expected completion: majority within 90 minutes. We're issuing a credit for the inconvenience and will share an RCA within 48 hours. If you'd like a prioritized replay window, reply to this thread."
Zoe T.: I'll escalate the two renewal-risk accounts to AMs and include offer of an extra week of trial/credit.
Chris H.: Post-incident action items: add S3 request histogram to the runtime dashboard, add circuit-breaker if >100 SlowDowns in 5m, and add prefetch for manifest read.
Nadia P.: CS tasks: 1) send segmented emails (high-touch first) at 07:00 UTC, 2) schedule office hours at 09:00 UTC, 3) log customer feedback into onboarding tracker.
Rafael G.: Replay job kicked at 05:55 UTC for affected tenants, progress showing 4/6 completed as of 06:05 UTC.
sre-oncall-bot: Alert cleared at 06:06 UTC (ingest retry queue stabilized).
Maya L.: After comms, we'll collect verbatim replies and tag any that request a follow-up as P1 for ENG.
Zoe T.: Confirmed AMs notified. I'll add CRM notes for the credits offered.
Nadia P.: Thanks — keep updates short here. We'll publish a customer-facing blurb on status.redwood.ai once RCA is ready. :white_check_mark:
